The structural foundation is the existing bound September financial fixture.
`current-financial-owners.json` overlays the directly exercised November 16
production autoledger, balance/store/ledger tally, deferred refusal, cashier
actor and exact intent, membership authority and freeze owners. Each function
is checked against its captured `pg_get_functiondef` MD5 before financial work.
The same capture provides the 31 actual enabled financial trigger definitions,
current registered original money doors, the exact intent/boundary/chip-request cold table
catalog and nonsensitive store coverage/mode configuration. All exercised
store modes are `refuse`; no guard is substituted or relaxed.

`disburse.sql` is the byte-exact original production disbursement owner read
through configured read-only access. The maintained candidate verifies its
preimage before adding the existing cashier-lane fence. Other original wallet
and departure owners remain in their separately retained source fixtures.

Only synthetic opening balances, participants and positions are seeded with
replication triggers bypassed. Every operation being qualified runs with
origin triggers and forces all deferred constraints before commit. The cron
adapter records the product job's registration without starting a scheduler.
The remote refusal recorder and its Vault/remote connection are not recreated;
the actual local refusing financial guard still runs. No live account records
or credentials are retained, and this isolated proof makes no production write
or provider-topology claim.
